passages: 28, Google DeepMind.Discussion and conclusionWe have introduced AlphaProof, an RL agent capable of proving complex mathematical problems within the formal environment of the Lean theorem prover.

At the 2024 International Mathematical Olympiad competition, our AI system, with AlphaProof as its core reasoning engine, solved three out of the five non-geometry problems, including the competition’s most difficult problem.

AlphaProof markedly improved state-of-the-art results on elite historical mathematics competition problems and, notably, proved three out of five problems at the 2024 International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) competition.
